tabs.html:
GPON OLT PON SFP Module G14D9C+++ – High-Power Class C+++ GPON Transceiver | OTECH BD


The GPON OLT PON SFP Module G14D9C+++ is a premium high-power Class C+++ optical transceiver designed for GPON OLT applications. With an extended optical budget, strong downstream transmission, and superior sensitivity, this module is ideal for ISPs and FTTH service providers in Bangladesh that require maximum performance for long-distance and high-split PON networks.


Engineered for 2.5Gbps downstream and 1.25Gbps upstream, it ensures stable GPON connectivity across long ranges using a sing

Key Features


  • High-Power Class C+++ GPON OLT SFP Module

            Supports long-distance GPON optical transmission with enhanced power and sensitivity.

  • 2.5Gbps / 1.25Gbps Data Rate

            Compliant with ITU-T G.984 GPON standards.

  • Extended Distance Coverage – Up to 20–40 km

           Ideal for high-split ratio FTTH networks.

  • Wavelengths

           1490nm TX (Downstream)

           1310nm RX (Upstream)

           1550nm Video Overlay (optional)

  • High Optical Budget (C+++)

            Provides exceptional performance for long-range GPON deployments.

  • Single-Fiber & SC/UPC Connector

            Transmits both upstream and downstream signals over one fiber.

  • Hot-Pluggable SFP Design

            Easy installation into GPON OLT ports.

  • DDM/DOM Support

           Real-time monitoring of temperature, optical power, and voltage.

  • Widely Compatible

            Works with most GPON OLT brands used in Bangladesh.
